family: GEOMETRIC / TRANSFORM RULES on the previous draw(s)

rules.definition: Adaptive: among 88 candidates (21 rotations, 22 reflections incl. 23-x, parity flip; each as image g(P) or complement C(g(P))) pick the one with least cumulative overlap with the next draw over all past transitions; ticket = that candidate applied to the previous draw. Ties -> first in order.
Mirror x->23-x of previous draw; orientation (image vs complement) fixed on draws 0..29: m0=5.4828 -> image
5-column slip (rows 1-5,...,21-22), Moore-neighbour density of previous draw, 11 lowest (seeded tiebreak 2511) or highest; orientation fixed on draws 0..29: a0=5.6552 -> highest
